request.deadline: 12 months from deployment; month-6 yield distribution; audit expected by July 1, 2026
deliverables: Deploy treasury-owned capital as USDM liquidity for Strike Finance V2
Return realized yield from the first six months to the Cardano Treasury at month 6
Return 100% of treasury-owned deployed assets plus remaining realized yield at month 12, minus any realized losses in wind-down scenarios
Provide monthly public transparency reports covering deployment status, liquidity utilization, P&L, yield, drawdown, stablecoin exposure, market quality metrics, distributions, and risks
Provide third-party assurance reports at deployment confirmation, month 6, and month 12
request.recipient: Independent multisig council composed of Rami from Snek, Phil from Surf, and James from Monetra/Moneta, with Strike Finance as the benefiting protocol.
request.what: 12-month productive treasury deployment into Strike Finance V2 liquidity infrastructure by selling ADA for USDM to provide stablecoin-denominated liquidity.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 9,000,000 ADA for a 12-month liquidity deployment into Strike Finance V2 rather than grant funding.
The deployed ADA will be sold for USDM, modeled at ADA = 0.15 USD to create approximately 1,350,000 USDM of stablecoin liquidity.
The deployment is modeled to generate approximately 900,000 ADA-equivalent annual yield at a 10% USD-denominated APR, but returns are not guaranteed.

Strike reports more than 1.13 billion USD in cumulative volume, over 968,000 trades, over 3,000 unique traders, over 1.16 million USD in protocol revenue, and over 3.25 million USD in liquidity provider profit.
Strike V2 reportedly produced 87,288,044 USD total volume, 410,800 trades, 2,681 users, and 30,105 USD revenue from 2026-03-20 through 2026-06-15.
The Strike Liquidity Provider vault is reported to have 985,271.59 USD TVL, 43.52% APR, +8.85% all-time return, 1.15% maximum drawdown, and a 4.97 Sharpe ratio after two months.
Operational custody would be handled by an independent multisig council, and Strike Finance would not have unilateral custody or control of treasury assets.
The proposal identifies risks including ADA price appreciation risk, USDM depeg or redemption risk, smart contract risk, yield underperformance, liquidity risk, and custody or operational risk.

Governance review is triggered if drawdown exceeds 8%, reporting is missed for two consecutive monthly cycles, or unresolved custody, accounting, stablecoin, redemption, or smart contract concerns arise, with mandatory review at 10% drawdown.
Strike aims to reach top-20 perpetual futures protocol status within 12 months and targets 1,000,000,000 USD 30-day volume, 5,000 traders, and 5,000,000 USD annualized revenue run rate.

summary: The anchor describes a 9,000,000 ADA treasury-owned liquidity deployment into Strike Finance V2, with modeled yield, multisig custody, reporting, and return terms, but it includes no reference links and much of the performance and market data is asserted inside the document.
